# Deny-by-default gate: Read/Glob/Grep OK, Edit/Write cwd-confined, Bash denied (RCE + exfil risk).
# Read-only tools are always safe; only file-mutation tools are gated to cwd.
# Read-only inspection tools — always permitted (output is redaction-hooked).
# Masked by the PostToolUse hook so on-disk secrets/PII aren't egressed unredacted.
# Refuse a symlinked final component without following it — the redirect primitive denied.
# Same no-resend env as the CLI route; set last so an ambient "0" cannot win.
#: Path keys redacted with ``carry=False``; NOT redact's `_NO_CARRY_KEYS` (``file`` holds content)
# type: ignore  # noqa: PLC0415 — optional SDK
# noqa: ANN001, ARG001
# `updatedToolOutput` is the only key the CLI honours; the old name leaked cleartext.
# type: ignore[list-item]
# noqa: PLC0415 — lazy: SDK stays optional
# noqa: ANN001, ARG001
# Must stay PreToolUse, never can_use_tool (a bare allow entry bypasses it); fail-closed
# File-mutation tools: allow only when the target stays inside the repo.
# Hand the SDK the resolved path, not the raw name, so an alias can't redirect it.
# Read-only tools need no decision: the bare allow entry below covers them.
# DENY-BY-DEFAULT, esp. Bash: host-shell RCE + credential exfil; re-adding it can't run.
# The PreToolUse hook above is the live gate; permission_mode/allowed_tools set availability
# "user" only: a scanned repo's own .claude/settings.json can never re-grant Bash or
# register a host hook into this Edit/Write-capable session (mirrors the via:cli
# route's --setting-sources user).
# Without this, a target repo's own .mcp.json server would be spawned into this
# session (mirrors cli_mcp.py's strict_mcp_config=True).
# Finding text/code snippets reach this prompt; verbatim keeps them from being
# parsed as an @path expansion or a slash command.
# noqa: ANN001
# noqa: PLC0415 — lazy: SDK stays optional
# .expired() tells OUR deadline apart from a TimeoutError raised inside the drain itself
# The cancelled `async for` above finalized its generator; receive_response() opens a new one
# (claude_agent_sdk.client.ClaudeSDKClient), so this second _drain is a fresh call, not a resume.
# noqa: ANN001
# noqa: PLC0415 — lazy: SDK stays optional
# noqa: ANN001
# Session clock, scaled the same way every other route scales its own agentic() timeout.
# The caller owns no scope around this call: the client's __aexit__ (close()) must run with
# no cancellation in flight, or the SDK skips its own terminate/kill escalation (subprocess_cli.py).
# accepted for parity; gate handles policy
# noqa: F401, PLC0415 — availability probe
# `None` = unspecified (read-only default), `[]` = none wanted; same as backends.llm.sdk.agentic
